title: Scrap-fed EAF steel installation, CN 7213.10, calendar year 2026
purpose: One set of inputs and one set of answers, read by both calculation engines. Neither engine owns it. See docs/fixtures/README.md.
regulatoryBasis: Regulation (EU) 2023/956, Annex II - iron & steel is charged on direct emissions only

processEmissions.conversionFactorSource: EU MRR (EU) 2018/2066 - tCO2 per tC from molar masses 44.010 / 12.011

exposure.status: BOTH INPUTS UNRESOLVED - spec 9. The arithmetic is pinned here so a later change to an engine cannot move it silently; the two numbers themselves are placeholders and must not be quoted to a customer.

backend.status: PARTIAL - the backend reproduces the indirect and precursor lines exactly and cannot express the direct ones at all. Do not make the backend the source of truth for a filed figure until `unsupported` below is empty.
mapping: Precursor quantities are ABSOLUTE TONNES in the backend request and PER TONNE OF OUTPUT in the fixture, so each is multiplied by production: scrap 1.08 x 10500 = 11340 t, pig iron 0.05 x 10500 = 525 t. The backend then divides by production again, so the contribution is identical - this is a change of units, not of arithmetic.

The backend returns decimal STRINGS at 80 significant digits. Every covered line below is asserted as an exact decimal equality, not within a tolerance: if the two engines are to swap places, they have to agree completely, not nearly.

expectedPartial.note: Both totals are the fixture's totals MINUS the whole direct line, because the two direct rows cannot be sent at all. They are pinned so that closing a gap below visibly moves them.

unsupported.reason: The fuel row is 148,800 m3 with an NCV of 0.0383 GJ/m3 and a factor of 0.0561 tCO2/GJ. UnitCode in app/models/calculation.py has no energy unit and no NCV field, so a source stream can only be tonnes x tCO2e/tonne. Pre-converting on the client would put the conversion that most often goes wrong outside the audit trace, which is the one thing the backend exists to hold.
unsupported.closedBy: Add GJ and an NCV to the source-stream model, mirroring certrace-portal/lib/cbam/units.ts toGJ.
unsupported.guard: POST a source stream with unit GJ - it must still be rejected.

unsupported.reason: Mass balance: 22.05 t x 1.00 carbon content x 3.664. The backend has no process-emission input type, and the model forbids extra fields. It could be smuggled in as a source stream with the emission factor set to 3.664, but the trace would then claim a standard calculation over an emission factor rather than a mass balance over a carbon content.
unsupported.closedBy: Add a process-emission input with its own trace method, carrying CO2_PER_C as a named constant.
unsupported.guard: POST process_emissions - it must still be rejected as an unknown field.

unsupported.reason: This fixture is deliberately one tier deep, so it does not exercise the difference - but PrecursorInput has no children and no own-process figure, and real chains are two to four tiers. A tree entered in the portal cannot round-trip.
unsupported.closedBy: Give PrecursorInput children and an own-process term, or port certrace-portal/lib/cbam/leontief.ts.
unsupported.guard: POST a precursor carrying children - it must still be rejected as an unknown field.

unsupported.reason: materialMix reports scrapRatio over total input mass, which is a different question from the mass-balance yield the portal shows. Neither is wrong; they are simply not the same number and must not be compared.
Formulas 5 and 6 are commercial, not MRV. They live only in the portal today. Listed here so that nobody reads their absence from the backend as an oversight.
